description: history.list renders every in-scope loop as a row through the ONE history.Row the CLI shares (H3): a populated set returns rows and NO statement, because the 'no history' caption belongs to the empty case only (P31's honest empty is never a gap). Each row is the merge's facts plus its floored cost, nothing more — the transcript is a second fetch (history.show), never pre-pulled into the list, so the list never carries a byte a person never opened.
